errors.text_span: и завършва през 2018 г. при около 95%
errors.evidence: The light blue line ('Oil and petroleum products') ends in 2018 at a value of approximately 94%, which is the same level as its starting point in 2008. The description incorrectly states the ending value is 95%.
The red line ('Solid fossil fuels') ends in 2018 at a value of approximately 43%. The stated value of 44% is a slight overestimation.
